name: spir
description: Supplier Product Information Registry (SPIR) - proof of concept

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w api && npm run db:seed -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
